command: node --input-type=module --import tsx -e <webhook list and create/delete safety classification using connect({ agentName })>

createWebhook.rationale: No controlled public HTTPS callback receiver was available for this PR4 run. Creating a webhook against an unowned or non-receiving URL would leave durable delivery state without a valid cleanup/readback target.

deleteWebhook.rationale: Delete was not attempted because create was not attempted and the run did not own an existing webhook id to delete.
